d8c27651065a6c701209ac8566f7cb92ecff8c81.hanzi: 他的愿望是学会自己缝上扣子。
d8c27651065a6c701209ac8566f7cb92ecff8c81.pinyin: tā de yuàn wàng shì xué huì zì jǐ fèng shàng kòu zi.

fd39d4f3971f9bdc9cc6ee6a592903528dd59071.hanzi: 她终于实现了多年的愿望。

2744adab9465478339d192c7c74c0af2545093d6.pinyin: Zhè suǒ xué xiào wèi lóng yǎ ér tóng tí gōng jiāo liú zhī chí.

5d093884dac65ef372448dedab148d70a6f47d71.hanzi: 朦胧月光照亮夜色中的穹苍。

1cf0279736bbd487379b8fdbfe02bfa4556d27e5.hanzi: 雾里的远山显得十分朦胧。

1cf0279736bbd487379b8fdbfe02bfa4556d27e5.english: The distant mountains look very hazy in the mist.

6298e9b14dcf7aae7de8c5fdb6bf18aa6d96327c.pinyin: zhè jiàn yù diāo xiǎo qiǎo líng lóng, shí fēn jīng měi.
6298e9b14dcf7aae7de8c5fdb6bf18aa6d96327c.english: This small jade carving is delicate and beautiful.

ff61c1f7f70bd6eb88e778f929bb45bb20abd057.hanzi: 她挑了一盏玲珑的小灯。
ff61c1f7f70bd6eb88e778f929bb45bb20abd057.pinyin: Tā tiāo le yì zhǎn líng lóng de xiǎo dēng.

d1c08fea643f6ac78ff069c5b6ebb8d811679795.hanzi: 她收到短信，得知自己中奖了。

7c0b1ffe0455e49eed549923b18b3e05dff07193.english: His noble ambition is to help sick people.

e0e77b4dd69dfa4f72cd1b65c59e70d7dd278088.hanzi: 他愿为崇高的目标付出努力。

224f369087317e7d261bbad7d7104e34a525d953.english: After the performance, the actors bowed to the audience.

b75aaddc2364b2191f662345a3be0ded9ddd60c0.hanzi: 骗子用灯光和烟雾装神弄鬼，终于被揭穿。
b75aaddc2364b2191f662345a3be0ded9ddd60c0.pinyin: piàn zǐ yòng dēng guāng hé yān wù zhuāng shén nòng guǐ, zhōng yú bèi jiē chuān.
b75aaddc2364b2191f662345a3be0ded9ddd60c0.english: The scammer used lights and smoke to fake supernatural activity, but was finally exposed.

chunks.gloss: (lit.) to pretend to be in contact with supernatural beings

219b2c5deacf923ec86ae7b85f2b8ebeda4c0009.hanzi: 歹徒被包围后仍负隅顽抗，拒不投降。
219b2c5deacf923ec86ae7b85f2b8ebeda4c0009.pinyin: dǎi tú bèi bāo wéi hòu réng fù yú wán kàng, jù bù tóu xiáng.
219b2c5deacf923ec86ae7b85f2b8ebeda4c0009.english: After being surrounded, the gangsters still resisted and refused to surrender.

chunks.gloss: putting up fierce resistance despite being surrounded

49e3fccdea9f258693187682b384a82aef58d330.hanzi: 影片中的敌军负隅顽抗，最终还是失败了。
49e3fccdea9f258693187682b384a82aef58d330.pinyin: yǐng piàn zhōng de dí jūn fù yú wán kàng, zuì zhōng hái shì shī bài le.
49e3fccdea9f258693187682b384a82aef58d330.english: The enemy in the film resisted stubbornly, but ultimately failed.

chunks.gloss: to put up fierce resistance despite being surrounded

c6c380969c813c4aa5400f11eb02bb92b50436d5.hanzi: 这位身经百战的队长在危急时刻十分冷静。
c6c380969c813c4aa5400f11eb02bb92b50436d5.pinyin: zhè wèi shēn jīng bǎi zhàn de duì zhǎng zài wéi jí shí kè shí fēn lěng jìng.
c6c380969c813c4aa5400f11eb02bb92b50436d5.english: This battle-hardened captain is very calm in critical moments.

chunks.gloss: lit. veteran of a hundred battles

c57bee3b8f41d64b632d25497807566d4ab90fcf.hanzi: 他身经百战，懂得怎样应对比赛中的变化。
c57bee3b8f41d64b632d25497807566d4ab90fcf.pinyin: tā shēn jīng bǎi zhàn, dǒng de zěn yàng yìng duì bǐ sài zhōng de biàn huà.
c57bee3b8f41d64b632d25497807566d4ab90fcf.english: He has been through many contests and knows how to handle changes during a match.

chunks.gloss: being highly experienced and seasoned by many challenges

10c3183719a675db923adc6b1617ea5a7eb2cbb1.hanzi: 车到山前必有路，我们先把眼前的准备做好。
10c3183719a675db923adc6b1617ea5a7eb2cbb1.pinyin: chē dào shān qián bì yǒu lù, wǒ men xiān bǎ yǎn qián de zhǔn bèi zuò hǎo.
10c3183719a675db923adc6b1617ea5a7eb2cbb1.english: We will find a way through when the time comes; for now, let us make the preparations we can.

chunks.pinyin: chē dào shān qián bì yǒu lù,
chunks.gloss: lit. when we get to the mountain, there'll be a way through

d5e2d8a53c3f73cd4d580ff1305fe4f7e472ee73.hanzi: 她相信车到山前必有路，没有被暂时的困难吓倒。
d5e2d8a53c3f73cd4d580ff1305fe4f7e472ee73.pinyin: tā xiāng xìn chē dào shān qián bì yǒu lù, méi yǒu bèi zàn shí de kùn nán xià dào.
d5e2d8a53c3f73cd4d580ff1305fe4f7e472ee73.english: She believed a solution would appear when needed and was not daunted by the temporary difficulties.

chunks.pinyin: chē dào shān qián bì yǒu lù,
chunks.gloss: trusting that a solution will appear when the difficulty is reached

4e07a00caeddec16084525aca2d78eb1adc6ecd2.hanzi: 丢了重要的纪念物，她追悔莫及。
4e07a00caeddec16084525aca2d78eb1adc6ecd2.pinyin: diū le zhòng yào de jì niàn wù, tā zhuī huǐ mò jí.
4e07a00caeddec16084525aca2d78eb1adc6ecd2.english: After losing an important keepsake, she deeply regretted it, but it was too late to undo the loss.

129ec38fce82407980b6b4bd4a5c48ee84473a09.hanzi: 他错过道歉的机会，如今追悔莫及。
129ec38fce82407980b6b4bd4a5c48ee84473a09.pinyin: tā cuò guò dào qiàn de jī huì, rú jīn zhuī huǐ mò jí.
129ec38fce82407980b6b4bd4a5c48ee84473a09.english: He missed the chance to apologize and now regretted it, but could no longer put it right.

chunks.gloss: regret coming too late to change anything

b44124c4820d29a753c74aba314a2774efa31581.hanzi: 今天风和日丽，很适合到郊外散步。
b44124c4820d29a753c74aba314a2774efa31581.pinyin: jīn tiān fēng hé rì lì, hěn shì hé dào jiāo wài sàn bù.
b44124c4820d29a753c74aba314a2774efa31581.english: Today is sunny with a gentle breeze, perfect for a walk in the countryside.

chunks.gloss: pleasant sunny weather with a gentle breeze

d8801bd737d352854b3cadb494eae7a4ef8bc42f.hanzi: 在风和日丽的午后，孩子们在公园放风筝。
d8801bd737d352854b3cadb494eae7a4ef8bc42f.pinyin: zài fēng hé rì lì de wǔ hòu, hái zǐ men zài gōng yuán fàng fēng zhēng.
d8801bd737d352854b3cadb494eae7a4ef8bc42f.english: On a sunny afternoon with a gentle breeze, the children flew kites in the park.

chunks.gloss: pleasant sunny weather with a gentle breeze
guzheng (large zither with 13 to 25 strings, developed from the guqin during Tang and Song times)

54e29831552a03e94c267e41bf49d087eaf4fb2c.hanzi: 他不愿与那些不三不四的人来往。
54e29831552a03e94c267e41bf49d087eaf4fb2c.pinyin: tā bù yuàn yǔ nà xiē bù sān bù sì de rén lái wǎng.
54e29831552a03e94c267e41bf49d087eaf4fb2c.english: He didn't want to associate with those who were dishonest.

c66ab34ca4f8d86651de8353d2ab179327a9ec33.hanzi: 他说了一堆不三不四的话，让大家很反感。
c66ab34ca4f8d86651de8353d2ab179327a9ec33.pinyin: tā shuō le yī duī bù sān bù sì de huà, ràng dà jiā hěn fǎn gǎn.
c66ab34ca4f8d86651de8353d2ab179327a9ec33.english: He said a lot of nonsense, which made everyone very disgusted.

7d8a80952b3b190324537dbd30f5fa90eb735a6d.hanzi: 她为保护这片湿地大声疾呼，呼吁停止污染。
7d8a80952b3b190324537dbd30f5fa90eb735a6d.pinyin: tā wèi bǎo hù zhè piàn shī dì dà shēng jí hū, hū yù tíng zhǐ wū rǎn.
7d8a80952b3b190324537dbd30f5fa90eb735a6d.english: She spoke out to protect the wetland and called for an end to pollution.

chunks.gloss: making an urgent, emphatic appeal to attract public attention

43585bbd0a50d7c449988d7c594c3e8c871eab53.hanzi: 专家大声疾呼，提醒社会重视儿童阅读。
43585bbd0a50d7c449988d7c594c3e8c871eab53.pinyin: zhuān jiā dà shēng jí hū, tí xǐng shè huì zhòng shì ér tóng yuè dú.
43585bbd0a50d7c449988d7c594c3e8c871eab53.english: Experts speak out to remind society to pay attention to children's reading.

chunks.gloss: making an urgent, emphatic appeal to attract public attention
